analyst.summary: TBO Tek is a genuinely strong B2B travel-distribution platform, but its headline 83% revenue growth this quarter significantly overstates the underlying business: the more meaningful transaction-volume metric (GTV) grew a much more modest 29%, and profit grew just 2% year-on-year despite the revenue surge. Management called FY26 a stress test the platform passed, and growth in international hotel bookings (Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East) is real, but at roughly 65x earnings the stock is priced for far more consistent profit growth than it has just delivered - we'd want to see profit catch up to the revenue optics before getting more constructive.
